notes: All 15 Sunlight, Moonlight, and Starlight materials plus Raw Archeum and Archeum Ingot. Backgrounds removed with built-in image_gen; original database URLs, checksums, and edit prompts retained. Prior project textures backed up under build/archeum-prior-textures. Database original PNGs are under build/archeum-icon-originals.

image_processing.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied original 48x48 ArcheAge icon, Sunlight Archeum Motes. Extract every separate small floating crystal mote; retain ALL the tiny fragments and their close colored rims. Replace only the dark square background and its broad background haze/shadow with genuine transparent PNG alpha. Preserve the foreground's exact original shape, orientation, relative size, position, internal art and pixel details. Keep the red family tint and tight colored glow immediately around the item so its Archeum type remains recognizable. Do not add new shapes, text, watermarks, checkerboards or a replacement backdrop. Do not redesign the object or change its colors. Preserve the full square canvas and original placement. Output at 48x48 if possible.

No gray mat, no connected cloudy silhouette, no translucent overlay, no checkerboard, no text, no extra fragments. Do not redesign the original fragments. Output a real transparent PNG, 48x48 if possible.
